column3: MT 30:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1 and repeats “A Psalm” before “of David”; “You have drawn me up” is rendered “You have lifted me up.”
“The remembrance of His holiness” is rendered “His holy name.”
“Life is in His favor” is rendered “His favor is for a lifetime,” and “in the evening weeping lodges” as “Weeping may last for the night.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB continues with a quotation in verses 9–10.
Close to the Hebrew; “will it give thanks to You” is rendered “Will the dust praise You?”
Close to the Hebrew; “wailing” is rendered “mourning,” and “joy” as “gladness.”
